BTW, <@!354681205842771973> pretty sure you should be able to use `effectiveGasPrice` in the txn.receipt too Ahhh, scratch that. Haha ok This is what the user paid, not what the miner received, my bad Geth still supports `gasPrice` on all txns, and it will return the actual gas price paid by users for a 1559 transaction, but eventually that field will be deprecated in 1559-style txns in favor of `effectiveGasPrice`, so if you are changing things now, it's more future proof to use `effectiveGasPrice` And then yeah, calculate that * `gasUsed` for all txns, then substract the block's `gasUsed` * `baseFeePerGas` and you know what went to the miner (and need to add block/uncle rewards, of course) Also question Regarding the transaction sending The transaction fee remains `gasPrice` * `gasUsed`? For a legacy transaction, yes For a 1559-style transacton, if you query the `gasPrice`, it will return the `maxFeePerGas` prior to it being mined, and the `effectiveGasPRice` after it is mined Because there is no way to know in advance what the cost will be, since it depends on the base fee https://twitter.com/MetaMask/status/1415391298153062401?s=20 https://twitter.com/danfinlay/status/1415394626576388100?s=20 looking forward to testing this!

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: How do you get the total txn fees paid now?

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: Because to get the amount burnt, you just need to look at the block header: `gasUsed` * `baseFeePerGas`. If you have an easy way to get the total txn fees, you can just do that and then subtract the burn total.

excerpts.author: alexssd7fp
excerpts.content: `gasUsed` from the tx receipt * `gasPrice` and that's for every transaction in the block

excerpts.author: timbeiko
